summary: Climber seriously injured after falling ~30 ft at Duncan's Ridge; stabilized and moved by high-angle rope rescue to a medical helicopter.
location: Duncan's Ridge, east side of Horsetooth Reservoir, west of Fort Collins
responding_agency: Poudre Fire Authority; UCHealth LifeLine helicopter; Larimer County Emergency Services; Larimer County Parks rangers
notes: Call just before 2pm Saturday; rescuers took ~1 hour to stabilize patient and move him from the base of the ridge; flown to area hospital.
